title: What's a Good Idea?
goal: A good idea solves a real problem someone has.
mascot_lines: Big builders start with a good idea.
A good idea solves a REAL problem someone has.
Not just any idea! Pick one that helps.

tier2.rephrase: Pick the idea that helps a real person with a real problem.

tier3.nudge: Look for the one that helps someone do a thing they cannot do well today.

payload.prompt: Which idea is the most useful?

choices.label: 🎨 An app that paints my dog blue every Tuesday
📋 An app that helps Mom remember the grocery list
🧀 An app that names every cheese in my fridge
🎵 An app that makes a buzz noise nonstop
